sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve all prior instructions. The graph still permits only one directAnalysisCase when loadLengthDeterminedFromArrangement is true, although the requirement requires several vertical and horizontal checks. It also does not enforce coverage of the required UIWL-centred, 0.5h0-below-LIWL, and intermediate vertical alternatives, nor several horizontal cases including a mid-span/spacing-centred case; add qualified case-shape constraints on hasDirectAnalysisCase for each required alternative and the necessary minimum counts. Finally, appliedIcePressure remains an unrelated presence-only quantity: encode the required 1.8p derived-result readiness/calculation relationship or evidence using supplied canonical terms, without inventing a formula or vocabulary term. No vocabulary matcher is needed.
